value.rationale: A canonical axis-exchange family of smooth eight-vertex Cayley lattice three-polytopes gives a complete sharp phase diagram distinguishing magic positivity, merely ordinary Ehrhart positivity, and negative coefficients. It has exact Diophantine boundary families and first-failure normalized volumes 97 and 141, yielding a reusable benchmark for preservation under Cayley operations rather than a generic counterexample.
